UWSGI_PORT.description: Port for uWSGI to bind to (if using uWSGI)

UWSGI_INI_PATH.description: Path to uWSGI ini configuration file

UWSGI_INI_APP.description: Path to uWSGI application-specific ini configuration file

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE.description: Optional ini file for uWSGI bind configuration

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_SECTION.description: Section in UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE to read bind settings from

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_IP_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for IP binding in UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_PORT_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for port in UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_WORKERS_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for number of workers in UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE

CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to main Cinder configuration file

SYSTEM_USER.description: System user under which service runs

SYSTEM_GROUP.description: System group under which service runs

USE_SYSLOG.description: Set to 'yes' to enable syslog logging

USE_LOGFILE.description: Set to 'no' to disable file logging

DAEMON_ARGS.description: Extra arguments to pass to daemon (not typically set here)
